request: Write a function that lets an author delete one of their comments.
contract: Write `delete_comment(conn, comment_id, author)` where `conn` is an open `sqlite3.Connection` and `comment_id` is an int.
Table: `comments(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, author TEXT, body TEXT)`.
Delete the comment only if it has that id and was written by that author. Return the number of deleted rows (0 or 1).
